title: LivePromotionApprovalRequest
description: Operator-issued dual-control sign-off recording a Phase 7 promotion to a *-live broker adapter. Validator rejects same-approver (approver_id_1 == approver_id_2) or blank IDs with error code approvers_must_differ. Emits exactly one LivePromotionApproved audit event when validation passes. See docs/ops/live-promotion-rollback.md §Sign-off recording. This PR only records the sign-off; the broker_target ConfigMap flip is still operator-driven post-sign-off.

broker_target.description: Target *-live broker adapter the promotion is signed-off against (e.g. 'tradier-live').

note.description: Operator-supplied free-form note recorded in the LivePromotionApproved audit event subject.
